Replace innerHTML and eval() sinks with safe textContent and DOM APIs
Store JWT session tokens in HttpOnly cookies instead of localStorage
Enforce HttpOnly and Secure flags on all session cookies
Enforce strong AES-GCM encryption ciphers for IPsec proposals
Disable deprecated Diffie-Hellman groups below DH Group 14
Verify file SHA-256 against threat intelligence hash databases
Quarantine files matching known YARA signatures immediately
Ensure secure SHA-256 or SHA-512 PRF functions are used

identity.name: VPN Crypto Analyzer
identity.creator: external-threat-team
identity.target_scope: IPsec VPN gateways, configurations, and traffic captures

intent.what_is_normal:
- IKEv2 with AES-256-GCM encryption
- DH group 14 (2048-bit) or higher
- Perfect Forward Secrecy enabled
- SHA-256 or stronger for integrity
intent.what_is_not_normal:
- Weak encryption: DES, 3DES, RC4
- Weak DH groups: 1, 2, 5
- Missing PFS
- MD5 or SHA-1 for integrity

intent.what_is_normal:
- Standard file signatures (PE, ELF, Mach-O headers)
- Hashes that are not in threat intelligence databases
- Low entropy (< 7.5) indicating uncompressed data
intent.what_is_not_normal:
- Known malicious hashes
- YARA rule matches
- High entropy (> 7.5) indicating packed/encrypted code
- Suspicious API calls
